briefdescription.para: EVAL-01..10 — WikiIndexStore evaluation metric tests (Recall@k / MRR / p95).

detaileddescription.para: Gate criterion (Wave B LLM): implementation of Recall@k / MRR / p95 reporting in WikiIndexStore (ROADMAP item Q4 2026). All tests run against a real in-memory RocksDB-backed WikiIndexStore; skipped automatically when RocksDB is unavailable in the build environment.
